risk_summary: The excerpt is generally transparent and quantitatively detailed, showing improving earnings, asset quality, liquidity, and loan-loss coverage. Risk disclosures rely partly on standard forward-looking language and broad, non-quantified references to economic, regulatory, interest-rate, and competitive risks. The overall tone is cautiously positive, although the declining net interest margin and exposure to collateral-driven losses under deflation remain relevant credit risks.
